experiment: story-2 30-40 s / ~92 words; spoken hook names Wirtz + Klopp + 5-0, payoff ~1.5 s; beat 1 starts on 'Paraguay' (no case-file preamble); question at ~20 s

beats.say: Five-nil. Wirtz scores two for Klopp's Germany.
beats.caption: 5-0. Wirtz scores two for Klopp's Germany.

beats.say: Paraguay. This summer, they knocked Germany out of the World Cup. Then Klopp replaced Nagelsmann.
beats.caption: Paraguay. This summer, they knocked Germany out of the World Cup. Then Klopp replaced Nagelsmann.

card.sub: round of 32 · Jürgen Klopp then replaced Julian Nagelsmann

beats.say: Klopp says that over the summer, it felt like the new coach would have to drink himself into a stupor just to look at this team. Then? Love at first sight.
beats.caption: Klopp says that over the summer, it felt like the new coach would have to drink himself into a stupor just to look at this team. Then? Love at first sight.

card.text:
…DRINK HIMSELF INTO A STUPOR…
BUT THEN I ARRIVED, AND IT WAS
*LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT.*

beats.say: Liverpool signed him in a club-record hundred-and-sixteen-million deal. Can he bring this form back?
beats.caption: Liverpool signed him in a club-record £116m deal. Can he bring this form back?

beats.say: On the hour, Wirtz wins it off Dumfries, fires in from outside the box. Then a second.
beats.caption: On the hour, Wirtz wins it off Dumfries, fires in from outside the box. Then a second.

card.sub: won the ball from Netherlands captain Denzel Dumfries · second from a Brajan Gruda cut-back

beats.say: Group winners. Klopp says no-one will question them for at least three or four months. Follow for the next Scout File.
beats.caption: Group winners. Klopp says no-one will question them for at least three or four months. Follow for the next Scout File.

card.sub: Germany into the Nations League quarter-finals as group winners
